scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the already-started unlock and decoration setup for Fair Oaks Pavilion B before relatives begin arriving.
Emerging Need: Dorian reaches the shelter and starts the lockbox process, but the access session is paused after code failure; staff will continue only with the reservation holder's authorization.
Decision Context: Calendar and desk contact establish the window and route; a stored coordination note identifies the reservation holder and the limited condition under which she agreed to be interrupted.
Consequence: Timely coordination can restart the same shelter setup while supplies are still at the gate; after the authorization cutoff, decorations cannot be placed before arrival time.

parameter.title: Fair Oaks Pavilion B decoration setup
parameter.description: Bring table bins and banner box before relatives arrive at 10:45.

parameter.name: Sacramento County Picnic Desk
parameter.notes: Handles same-day lockbox authorization for Fair Oaks Park shelters; weekday phone line is staffed during morning setup windows.

parameter.content: At Fair Oaks Pavilion B with the table bins and banner box. Starting the lockbox setup now so we can get everything inside before people arrive.

parameter.subject: Fair Oaks Pavilion B lockbox session paused
parameter.body: The access session for Fair Oaks Pavilion B is paused after two failed code attempts. Staff cannot release a new code to an unlisted setup helper. To continue today's setup, the reservation holder must phone the picnic desk with access token LX-884 by 10:05 AM.

parameter.subject: Fair Oaks Pavilion B authorization window closed
parameter.body: The 10:05 AM authorization cutoff for access token LX-884 has passed. The lockbox code is disabled until the noon reset, and unlisted setup helpers cannot enter Pavilion B before the scheduled arrival window.
